title: Moroccan Pecan Tagine
description: A sweet and exotic dessert inspired by Moroccan cuisine, featuring a gooey pecan topping and a rich tagine sauce.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add luscious honey, brown sugar, flour, egg, salt, cinnamon, and ginger. Cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce thickens.
In a separate bowl, mix together pecans and a pinch of salt.
Transfer the sauce to a 9x9-inch baking dish and top with the pecan mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pecans are golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
